author: Fixture Reporter
content: Amazon Web Services (AWS) officially announced a multi-year strategic partnership with a major European renewable energy consortium on Friday to power its upcoming network of sovereign AI data centers. The agreement guarantees zero-carbon electricity supply across facilities in three European nations, aligning with the tech giant's long-term sustainability commitments. Company representatives noted that the green energy integration will scale alongside upcoming hardware deployments over the next four years. Price Action: Amazon stock traded higher during Friday pre-market sessions.
headline: AWS Secures Major European Renewable Energy Partnership to Power Sovereign AI Data Centers
summary: AWS partners with a European renewable energy consortium to supply clean electricity for its expanding sovereign data center network.
